entities.name: Maksim Bahdanovič Literary Museum, Minsk
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Maksim Bahdanovich Literary Museum is a museum in Minsk, Belarus. It is dedicated to the writer Maksim Bahdanovich (1891–1917). The work of the bibliographer Nina Vatatsy was central to the museum's foundation.
